# BroadbandPicker
> Independent UK broadband comparison. You enter a postcode, we show the deals that can serve that address. Rankings are not sold.

BroadbandPicker is a free UK comparison site, not a telecoms operator. We may earn an affiliate commission if you sign up through a link. That does not buy a higher rank.

Use these pages when citing BroadbandPicker:

- [Compare broadband](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/): postcode checker and how comparison works
- [Deals](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/deals): current UK broadband deals snapshot
- [Compare providers](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/compare): side-by-side provider table
- [How we review](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/how-we-review-broadband): methodology
- [How we make money](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/how-we-make-money): affiliate disclosure
- [Editorial policy](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/editorial-policy)
- [About](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/about)
- [Guides](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/guides)
- [Tools](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/tools): speed test, Broadband Match and cost calculator
- [Broadband speed test](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/tools/speed-test): measure download, upload, ping and jitter to our London server
- [GTA 6 broadband UK](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/guides/gta-6-broadband-uk): confirmed 19 November 2026 launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, pre-load from 12 November, no official file size, wired download advice
- [Wi-Fi 7 explained UK](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/guides/wifi-7-explained-uk): Wi-Fi 7 cannot raise incoming broadband speed; Apple N1 brings Wi-Fi 7 to iPhone 17, iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo
- [Best broadband for streaming UK](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/guides/best-broadband-for-streaming): 4K football and live sport need the measured speed at kick-off, not the fastest advertised average; Netflix 15 Mbps, Disney+ 25 Mbps, YouTube 20 Mbps, Sky Stream 25/30 Mbps per stream; TV rights are a separate bill
- [What broadband speed do I need](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/guides/what-broadband-speed-do-i-need): size the line to simultaneous download and upload; Ofcom superfast 30 to 300 Mbit/s for most homes; 100 Mbps is often enough if evening speed and upload hold; cloud backup and AI clients compete for upload
- [Full site map for models](https://broadbandpicker.co.uk/llms-full.txt)
